A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Here in the outside world, he learns the cruel government minister who raised him is hatching a plan to wipe out the gypsies, so he resolves to protect his new friends. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline.

After the murder of his father Mufasa, young lion prince Simba flees his African kingdom, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery as he clashes with his wicked uncle Scar. Director Jon Favreau's animated remake of Disney's 1994 blockbuster, featuring the voices of Donald Glover, Beyonce Knowles and Seth Rogen.

A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.
Sing along with your favorite songs from 'Lady and the Tramp' with on-screen lyrics.

Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

A sprinter fails to qualify for the Jamaican Olympic squad, but refuses to give up his dream. Learning that a former US bobsleigh coach is living nearby, he seizes the chance to shine in an entirely different sport, and cajoles three of his friends to join him in training for the 1988 Winter Olympics in the far less tropical environment of Canada. Fact-based comedy, with John Candy, Leon, Doug E Doug and Malik Yoba.

A crew of colonists sent to populate an alien planet have their mission diverted by a mysterious signal. After landing on a nearby world, they discover what became of the ill-fated Prometheus mission. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller, starring Katherine Waterston, Michael Fassbender and Danny McBride.

The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

A greetings card employee looks back on his relationship with the woman he loves, after she has seemingly left him for good. As he recalls the key events of the 500 days he knew her, the ups and downs of their romance are presented in random order. Romantic comedy, starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt and Zooey Deschanel.

A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

Aspiring fashion journalist Rebecca Bloomwood accepts a position writing for a financial magazine. As she sets the publishing world alight with her unique brand of consumer advice, Rebecca is forced to confront her own purchasing habits and begins to question whether rampant spending sprees are the way to true happiness. Comedy, starring Isla Fisher, Hugh Dancy, Krysten Ritter and Joan Cusack.

p.t: World's Greatest Train Journeys from Above
p.d: Norway's Bergen line, running from Bergen to Oslo, is filmed from the air as it passes along the fjords of Western Norway, rises to the snowy Hardanger Plateau, and descends through deep forests. Along the way, we learn how a dedicated team of people keep the line open in a challenging environment: clearing snow and ice, deterring wildlife, and repairing damaged trains

p.t: World's Greatest Train Journeys from Above
p.d: This episode follows the luxury El Chepe train from above and on the ground. The route is a wonder of Mexican engineering that took 100 years to build and winds through the world's largest canyon region, Copper Canyon

The programme focuses on the tragic events of September 1961, when a Douglas DC-6 operated by Transair Sweden, carrying Dag Hammarskjöld, the second Secretary-General of the United Nations, crashed en route to cease-fire negotiations in Northern Rhodesia during the Congo Crisis. All 16 passengers and crew members were killed.

In June 1982, the engines of British Airways Flight 009 failed after it flew through volcanic ash caused by an eruption and the plane began falling from the sky. Minutes before it would have crashed into the sea the engines roared back to life - narrowly avoiding a catastrophe. The investigation looks at the lessons learned from the incident, which changed the way pilots were trained

Summer is the best! You can chase a ball, run on the grass, play badminton, and bask in the sun. But what is there to do when winter comes? Absolutely nothing! You can't even kick a ball.
Mom Saur grows the tastiest berries in the world. Everyone loves them: Dad Saur, Tyra, Ricky, the pterodactyls... Oh! Those pterodactyls again!
On some days, things just don't go right. The kind of day that gets off on the wrong foot! Unlucky days. Before, every fifth day was like this for Ricky. But everything is about to change!
There's quite the commotion in Dinocity! A journalist from a well-known TV program has announced that the person who makes the most interesting report about the life of the city will appear on TV.

Grandpa Saur has always dreamed of some extraordinary adventure! For example, to meet a real space alien! For many years, grandfather has been looking in a telescope in the hopes of spotting an alien.
Did you think invisibility cloaks existed only in fairytales? No way! Boo has his dad's wildlife photography cloak. It lets you camouflage with any environment, so that no one will notice you.
Ricky and Tyra love playing with their dad. But they're already a little tired of Dinopoly, ring-toss, and puzzles. But resourceful Dad Saur has come up with a new game: The Floor is Lava.
One day, Ricky finds a lamp in a pile of old trash. It looks just like a magic lamp with a genie inside! Though no genie actually comes out of it.
What can be scarier than stories told late at night, in a tent, by the lamplight? When shadows tremble on the wall, and even the sweetest little ghost story sounds seriously scary!
Kraken is the favourite pet of the Saur family! He follows Ricky and Tyra everywhere. This time, Kraken was playing with them in the yard. And then he got lost!
Today is Good Deeds Day in DinoCity! The townsfolk are planting flowers, feeding homeless pterodactyls, and helping each other. Ricky also decided to do something really kind.

Dinosaurs, as you know, can be very different. Some prefer grass; others eat meat. Some of them fly, and some do not have wings. And Ricky is the one without wings. If only he could fly at least once!
One day, Ricky, Tyra, and their neighbours, Boo, Tim, and his sister, decided to build sand castles.
Mr. Zelur has a day off but no time to rest-he needs to take the children to the dentist. Only baby Roy doesn't want to go with them.
